policy.privacy_intro: This policy explains how AWTAD SERVICES uses your information when you register and request home services in Al-Qassim and Al Majmaah.
policy.data_body: We store your name and the sign-in methods you add, such as a username, email or phone number. Service information includes your selected location, requests, offers, conversations, attachments and verification documents you upload.
policy.purpose_body: We use this information to operate your account, connect customers and providers, manage requests and offers, send service notifications and handle complaints and disputes.
policy.location_body: Device location is optional. You can select an area, city and neighborhood manually. When you use the map or location button, the point’s coordinates are sent to the map service to help identify an address. Check the city and neighborhood before saving because address detection may be approximate.
policy.sharing_body: Public provider profiles are visible to people looking for services. Request participants exchange the information needed to perform the work. AWTAD SERVICES uses Vercel for hosting, Neon for data storage and OpenStreetMap for maps. Administrators may review conversation records when resolving disputes under the terms and access permissions.
policy.records_body: Requests, offers, conversations and attachments are retained to support service tracking and dispute resolution. Passwords are stored as one-way hashes and are not displayed in profiles.
policy.controls_body: You can correct account details and location in your profile and clear saved coordinates. Share only information needed for the service. Keep passwords and unnecessary sensitive information out of conversations and attachments.
policy.terms_unavailable: The terms could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
policy.default_terms_html:
Terms and conditions — AWTAD SERVICES

1. Acceptance of use
By registering with AWTAD SERVICES, you agree to these terms and confirm that you have reached the age of majority under the laws applicable in your country.

2. Accurate information
You undertake that all information you provide (name, phone number, email, location and documents) is correct. Misleading information may lead to immediate suspension of your account.

3. Service and payment
The platform connects customers with service providers. You agree on the work and price directly. The platform acts as an arbitrator in disputes according to conversation records and the agreement.

4. Conversation review for quality and reliability
You acknowledge and consent that platform administrators may review text and voice conversations and location-sharing records between you and the other party, exclusively in the following cases:

  • When either party opens a dispute or complaint
  • To verify the agreement was carried out and protect rights
  • To check for content that violates the law or public decency
  • To verify the reliability of new service providers before approving them

Every review is recorded in an internal audit log with its time and the staff member’s identity. It is not used for marketing or for purposes outside these cases.

5. Personal data protection
Your information will not be shared with a third party without your permission except by court order. You may request deletion of your account and all your data at any time.

6. Acceptable conduct
The following are strictly prohibited: fraud, insults, offensive content, requesting or paying amounts outside the platform, and impersonation. A violation leads to permanent suspension.

7. Changes to the terms
The platform may update this document. After any material change, you will be asked to accept the terms again when you next sign in.

8. Applicable law
These terms are subject to the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the member countries according to your location.

help.title: User guide
help.subtitle: Clear steps to request or provide a service with AWTAD SERVICES, from signing up to completing the work.
help.choose_role: Choose what you want to do
help.client_intro: Start with the service you need, compare offers and agree with the right provider.
help.provider_intro: Tell customers about your profession, services and work area, then send clear offers for suitable requests.

browse.title: Choose a service and sign in
browse.body: Browse services such as plumbing, electrical work and yard cleaning. To create a request, sign in or create an account and choose “{{role_client}}”.

details.title: Describe what you need
details.body: Write a title and description of the work and select the service. Add helpful photos, and specify a preferred time and budget if you wish.

location.title: Check the service location
location.body: Your saved account address and location are filled in automatically. Check them and edit them for this request if needed. To update your account for future requests, select “Save this location as my default for future requests”; the change is saved after the request is sent successfully. Pick the point on the map or use device location.

offers.title: Compare offers and accept one
offers.body: Open your request details to review provider offers. Compare the price, duration, rating and service location. Choose “Negotiate with messages” on an offer to clarify details before accepting the one that suits you.

chat.title: Confirm the agreement in chat
chat.body: Open the offer chat to clarify the work, time, address and price. Record audio up to 60 seconds or video up to 20 seconds, or attach a file from your device. Allow microphone access for audio, and camera and microphone access for video, then check the preview and press Send. Attachments can total up to 3.5 MB. After accepting an offer, confirm who travels to whom.

finish.title: Confirm completion and leave a review
finish.body: Follow the status in the request details. You can mark work as started when it begins and confirm completion after the service is done. Reviews become available once the request is completed.

signup.title: Complete your account with your phone number
signup.body: Choose “{{role_provider}}”, then enter your name, phone number and password. Complete your account address, select your city and neighborhood, then pick a point on the map or use device location and confirm it. Provider registration does not require an email address or username.

profile.title: Choose your profession and services
profile.body: Select your profession and at least one service you provide, then choose your work city, neighborhood where available, and how you provide the service. If customers visit your shop, add its address and location separately in the business details. Your account address stays private. You can update these details in your profile.

find.title: Find suitable requests
find.body: Browse service requests from your provider account or the opportunities page. Open a request and read the work description and location before making an offer.

quote.title: Send a clear offer
quote.body: For an open request, enter your price, expected duration and a message explaining what the work includes. You can negotiate with the customer in the offer chat before acceptance using text, voice messages or video. Follow the offer status in your account; the customer chooses the offer that suits them.

work.title: Coordinate, complete the work and review
work.body: When your offer is accepted, open the request chat and agree on the time and location. Confirm completion after the work is done. You can review the customer once the request is completed.

help.venue_intro: The provider chooses how they deliver the service during registration or in their profile. Check this before accepting an offer and agree on the location in chat.

price.question: Is the displayed price final?
price.answer: Displayed service prices are estimates. The final price and time are set in the provider offer you accept. Confirm the work and price before it begins.

areas.question: Where is the service available now?
areas.answer: We are launching in Al-Qassim and Al Majmaah. Select your city and neighborhood from the available options in a request or profile. Finding a suitable provider depends on the offers you receive.

tracking.question: How do I follow my request?
tracking.answer: Customers can open “My Requests”, then a request’s details. Providers can follow their requests and offers in their account. Open the offer chat to negotiate and use it to coordinate work after acceptance. The tracking page shows a location when a participant shares it while the page is open.

dispute.question: What should I do if there is a disagreement?
dispute.answer: In the assigned request’s details, choose “Open a dispute”, select a reason, explain the issue and attach supporting information if you wish. Follow replies and updates on the dispute page.

subscription.question: How do I check provider subscription plans?
subscription.answer: Open “Subscription” in the provider account to see the displayed plans, prices, durations and features. Review the plan details before choosing one.

language.question: How do I change the language and translate messages?
language.answer: Use the language button at the top of the page to choose Arabic, English, Urdu, Hindi or Bengali. User-written text and names stay as entered. In chat, choose “Translate on my device” for text or attachment audio, and select the recording language for audio. The feature needs your consent to download large models the first time, then processes the message on your device; some devices may not support it. The original stays available. Confirm the price and time with the other person.
